description: Fixed set of field-sized polygons for benchmarking POST /area (docs/DESIGN.md §5.7). Centred on randomly sampled Indiana soil map units that have overlay coverage, in five size classes so the benchmark spans a realistic range of map-unit counts rather than one shape of query. The set is larger than a benchmark run's request count so that every request in a cold run is a genuine first touch, without flushing inside the timed loop. Committed so runs are comparable across machines and dates.
